review.assessment: The change overrides the default thirty-day month assumption by returning twenty-eight days specifically for February in the `days_in` helper, allowing downstream refund logic to use calendar-accurate day counts for that month.

findings.call: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); from subs.prorate import days_in; print(days_in(2024, 2))"
findings.defect: Leap years are ignored. The function hardcodes twenty-eight for all Februaries regardless of the year.
